source.note: Real E5 stage-3 "full screw disassembly" run (E5-100Hz, 2026-11-25 10:54:58 local). Segment starts at the approach apex tcp_z=1205.02 mm (last frame before the downward approach) and ends at the last recorded sample. Inside the segment: press/approach -> contact at z=1032.46 mm -> spindle energised (DO15=1, then DO16=1) with Fz rising 5.09 -> 19.62 N and Mz -6.19 -> -0.1 N*m -> lift +25 mm to z=1063.72 mm -> retract to the 1200.7 mm hover. q/dq are vendor RobotStateRt DEG / DEG-S from the RT UDP stream (tcp_z_mm from the same record); f/m come from the 100 Hz force recorder of the SAME run, aligned by nearest-neighbour wall_ms. Fz is the raw sensor value and still contains the uncompensated tool-gravity projection (about 5-6 N baseline on the approach pose), so net contact is ~9-13 N under the peak. DI16 (clamp gate) is 0 for this whole run - the gate was asserted in the earlier TCP-era run E5_Task_Contact_20261124_182800, not here.

channels.fx..mz: force_e5_100hz.csv -> fx,fy,fz (N), mx,my,mz (N*m); nearest-neighbour on wall_ms
channels.tcp_*: rt_stream_100hz_20261125_105458.csv -> tcp_z_mm (mm); mirrored in top-level tcpZmm[]
channels.spindleIo: force_e5_100hz.csv -> do15,do16,di16; exposed as top-level events[]
channels.tau_1..6: <missing> - no joint-torque column in force_e5_100hz.csv; tau_1..6 only exist in the older TCP-era joints_live.csv files, which have no dq_real_*
channels.di16: present but constant 0 for this run (clamp gate never asserted here)

alignment.method: nearest-neighbour on wall_ms, 100 Hz grid anchored at segmentStartWallMs
